subject: Air export MUC to LIM - Vega only
body:
Good evening,

kindly quote 5 cartons of optical components MUC to LIM, 850 kg gross, 3.1 cbm, ready 27.11., we bring the goods to Munich airport.

We have a framework contract with Vega Skyfreight, so please quote Vega Skyfreight only, no other airline. All-in price in EUR please.

Best regards
Sophie Brandl
Supply Chain
Alpen Optik GmbH
